title: Rampart PII Worker

allow_network.title: Allow model download during activation
allow_network.description: Keep disabled after the model has been prepared in the local cache.

max_latency_ms.title: Per-sanitizer callback latency budget
max_latency_ms.description: Bounds queue wait plus classification for each sanitizer callback. One managed call can invoke both request and response callbacks.

max_concurrency.title: Maximum concurrent inference callbacks
max_concurrency.description: Bounds active native inference calls. Saturated callbacks wait within max_latency_ms and fail closed when the deadline expires.

max_content_chars.title: Maximum aggregate semantic content characters
max_content_chars.description: Larger sanitizer payloads fail closed before model inference.
